build.buildCommand: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@9.15.9 --activate && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile=false && pnpm --filter @dama/shared build && pnpm --filter @dama/game-engine build && pnpm --filter web build

deploy.startCommand: pnpm --filter web exec serve -s dist -l tcp://0.0.0.0:${PORT:-4173}
